summary: Create an OAuth2 token from the command line with `aap-gateway-manage create_oauth2_token --user <username>`; an invalid or missing user produces an error.
questions: How do I create an OAuth2 token from the command line?
create_oauth2_token error user does not exist

answer_card.title: Create a token with aap-gateway-manage
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
aap-gateway-manage create_oauth2_token --user example_user
# New OAuth2 token for example_user: <token>
```
The user must exist, or the command fails.
